summary.title: Fixing main.py to print Hello, world!
summary.body: I fixed two bugs that stopped `python3 main.py` from running: `main.py` imported from a nonexistent `greetings` module instead of `greeter`, and `greeter.py` was missing the colon after `def greet(name)`. After correcting both, the program runs cleanly and prints `Hello, world!
